L.title: Gold Zakat Calculator
L.subtitle: Investment Gold & Jewellery — Grams, Tola & Ounces
L.madhabNote: Majority schools exempt personally worn jewellery. Hanafi requires Zakat on all gold.
L.hawl: I confirm this gold has been in my possession for one full lunar year (hawl)
L.notEligibleDesc: Total pure gold is below nisab (85g) or hawl is not confirmed.
L.disclaimer: This is a calculation aid for general information only. Not a fatwa. Consult a qualified scholar. Jewellery rulings differ by school of jurisprudence. Use the gold price on your Zakat due date.
